shots.what_changes: The cleared trail widens and further distorts the lights beyond, while fresh beads gather and begin to descend.

description.text: A locked, medium wide view holds on a rain-streaked bus window at night.
The glass is beaded and veined with water, and beyond it the city lights sit far out of focus as soft amber and white smears.
The dim interior edge of the bus is barely legible in the lower corner of the frame, giving the window its shallow depth.
Droplets track downward in slow, uneven lines, catching faint moving reflections from outside as the wet pane shifts between clarity and blur.
Rain beads and streaks across the dark bus window.
The first droplets begin to track downward in slow, uneven lines.
Soft rain patters against the glass.
Out-of-focus city lights glow as soft amber and white smears beyond the wet pane.
A low, muffled bus engine hum sits beneath the rain.
The camera holds a static shot.
The shot cuts to a closer, locked view of the same rain-covered glass.
One larger droplet trembles at the center of the frame, meets a smaller bead beside it, and the two merge into a single heavier drop.
That combined drop slides downward, clearing a narrow, wavering path through the condensation.
Behind the glass, the blurred lights shift only slightly, keeping attention on the water and the dim, cool reflections sliding across the surface.
The camera holds closer on the rain-covered glass.
A larger droplet trembles and meets a smaller bead beside it.
The two droplets merge into one heavier drop.
A soft wet tick sounds as the droplets merge.
The heavier drop slides downward, opening a thin clear trail through the condensation.
Faint rain ticks on the glass.
The camera holds a static shot.
The shot transitions to an extreme close-up on the wet pane, still locked and steady.
The clear trail left by the sliding drop widens and distorts the city lights behind it into long, trembling streaks.
More fine beads gather along the top edge and start to creep downward, each one catching a small point of reflected light.
The glass holds its dim, cool reflections while the night beyond remains unfocused, and the surface texture shifts from beaded condensation to a glossy, wavering channel of water.
The camera settles into an extreme close-up on the wet pane.
The clear trail widens and distorts the city lights into long, trembling streaks.
Fine beads gather along the top edge of the glass.
Fresh beads begin to creep downward through the condensation.
A faint watery trickle runs down the pane.
Soft rain continues to patter against the glass.
The camera holds a static shot.
